description: This file contains multiple class implementations of Orleans grains, each implementing specific interfaces and managing internal state with methods for setting, incrementing, and retrieving values. It appears to define various grain classes with different functionalities and state variables.

classes.name: DoSomethingEmptyGrain
classes.description: A grain class implementing IDoSomethingEmptyGrain with a single integer state A and methods to manipulate it.

classes.name: DoSomethingEmptyWithMoreGrain
classes.description: A grain class implementing IDoSomethingEmptyWithMoreGrain with a single integer state A and an additional method DoMore.

classes.name: DoSomethingWithMoreGrain
classes.description: A grain class implementing IDoSomethingWithMoreGrain with two integer states A and B, and methods to manipulate both.

classes.name: DoSomethingWithMoreEmptyGrain
classes.description: A grain class implementing IDoSomethingWithMoreEmptyGrain with a single integer state A and a method DoMore.

classes.name: DoSomethingCombinedGrain
classes.description: A grain class implementing IDoSomethingCombinedGrain with three integer states A, B, and C, and methods to manipulate all three.
